section: Elections - delimitation, model code of conduct, EVM-VVPAT, NOTA, election petitions

accepted.s: The Supreme Court hearing on EVM totalisers, referred to in the context of election transparency, was scheduled on which date?
accepted.x: The Supreme Court hearing on EVM totalisers was scheduled for 2 September 2026.
accepted.tq: Use the exact-date distinction among closely related current-affairs developments.

accepted.s: Which one of the following correctly describes the Tamil Nadu Assembly's position on delimitation in August 2026?
o: It supported delimitation exclusively on the basis of the 2011 Census without any freeze.
It demanded a permanent freeze at 543 Lok Sabha seats and a 2.2:1 Lok Sabha–Rajya Sabha ratio.
It proposed abolishing the Rajya Sabha after delimitation.
It demanded an increase of Lok Sabha seats to 850 and a 1:2.2 Lok Sabha–Rajya Sabha ratio.
accepted.x: The Tamil Nadu Assembly asked for a permanent freeze at 543 Lok Sabha seats and proposed a 2.2:1 Lok Sabha–Rajya Sabha ratio.
accepted.tq: Separate the specific institutional demand from broader positions on delimitation.

accepted.s:
With reference to Andhra Pradesh's representation in the Lok Sabha, consider the following statements:
1. Andhra Pradesh has four reserved Lok Sabha seats for Scheduled Castes.
2. Andhra Pradesh has one reserved Lok Sabha seat for Scheduled Tribes.
3. Both categories of reserved seats are equal in number.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: Andhra Pradesh has four Scheduled Caste-reserved Lok Sabha seats and one Scheduled Tribe-reserved Lok Sabha seat. Therefore, the two categories are not equal in number.
accepted.tq: Split the numerical comparison from the two individual figures.

accepted.s:
Match List-I with List-II regarding significant milestones in India's election system.

List-I
 a. EVM first used at Parur
 b. VVPAT first used at Noksen
 c. NOTA introduced

List-II
 i. 1982
 ii. 2013
 iii. 2013

Select the correct answer using the code given below:
accepted.x: EVM was first used at Parur in 1982, while VVPAT was first used at Noksen in 2013 and NOTA was introduced in 2013.
accepted.tq: Start with the sure historical pair and then distinguish the two events sharing the same year.

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements regarding the Constitution (131st Amendment) Bill, 2026:
1. It proposed raising the Lok Sabha ceiling from 550 to 850.
2. It proposed delimitation on the basis of the 2011 Census.
3. It was passed by the Lok Sabha with the required special majority.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: The Bill proposed increasing the Lok Sabha ceiling from 550 to 850 and conducting delimitation on the 2011 Census. It was defeated, not passed with the required special majority.
accepted.tq: Identify the false outcome statement while retaining the two substantive proposals.

accepted.s: Why have southern States expressed apprehension regarding population-based delimitation?
o: They oppose the use of electronic voting machines in parliamentary elections.
They fear that States such as Uttar Pradesh, Bihar and Rajasthan may gain seats at their expense.
They fear that the Rajya Sabha will become a directly elected chamber.
They fear that all Lok Sabha seats reserved for Scheduled Castes will be abolished.
accepted.x: Southern States fear that population-based delimitation would transfer political representation towards more populous States such as Uttar Pradesh, Bihar and Rajasthan.
accepted.tq: Link the policy principle of population-based delimitation with its regional representation effect.

accepted.s: The EAC-PM proposal of August 2026 relating to Lok Sabha representation envisaged which of the following?
o: Increasing the Lok Sabha ceiling directly from 550 to 850 without changing constituencies
Merging 170 constituencies to reduce the Lok Sabha to 543 seats
Splitting 170 oversized constituencies to reach 824 seats
accepted.x: The EAC-PM proposal envisaged splitting 170 oversized constituencies in order to reach a total of 824 Lok Sabha seats.
accepted.tq: Check both components of the proposal—the number of constituencies and the proposed total.

accepted.s: With reference to delimitation and Andhra Pradesh–Telangana representation, which one of the following is correct?
o: The increase in seats under Section 26 awaits the census after 2026.
The increase in seats under Section 26 is unrelated to any future census.
Section 26 concerns only the abolition of reserved seats in Andhra Pradesh.
The increase in seats under Section 26 was completed on the basis of the 2001 Census.
accepted.x: The Andhra Pradesh–Telangana seat increase under Section 26 awaits the census conducted after 2026.
accepted.tq: Match the statutory reference with the qualifying time condition instead of treating the provision as immediately operative.

accepted.s: In State of Karnataka v. Prathik Parasrampuria (2026), removal of black money from elections was described as which of the following?
o: A function of the Delimitation Commission alone
An exclusive duty of the Finance Commission
A core duty of the Election Commission of India
A responsibility transferred entirely to political parties
accepted.x: The Supreme Court case identified removing black money from elections as a core duty of the Election Commission of India.
accepted.tq: Ask which constitutional authority is associated with the responsibility described in the case.

accepted.s: The Election Commission of India delisted how many Registered Unrecognised Political Parties in 2026?
accepted.x: The Election Commission delisted 808 Registered Unrecognised Political Parties in 2026.
accepted.tq: Use the exact administrative figure and distinguish it from nearby delimitation numbers.

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements about the Election Commission of India:
1. It was constituted in 1950.
2. It is a permanent independent constitutional body.
3. Its IIIDEM trains election managers.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: The Election Commission was constituted in 1950, is a permanent independent constitutional body, and its IIIDEM provides training to election managers.
accepted.tq: When all three statements describe distinct institutional features, test whether the inclusive option is warranted.

accepted.s: Which district in Andhra Pradesh achieved 100 per cent digitisation of SIR enumeration forms in July 2026?
accepted.x: Alluri Sitharama Raju district achieved 100 per cent digitisation of SIR enumeration forms in July 2026.
accepted.tq: Test the precise place associated with the administrative achievement.
